limitations.note: The rewrite eliminated the repeated green reload but also turned red on immediately at reset and removed the original startup delay, whereas the reference fix only corrects the green rising-edge check.
The replacement kept the signal ports but removed the four public state parameters, so existing instantiations that override them would no longer compile.
The test asserted the rewrite’s immediate-red reset behavior instead of checking that the original reset and startup timing were preserved, so it passed despite the regression.
